_comment: Reviewed per-surface overrides for scripts/mongolian_bichig.mjs. Keys are lower-cased Cyrillic surfaces. Every row cites the source(s) its bichig was checked against. 'when_gloss' (regex, case-insensitive) restricts a homograph row to tokens whose English gloss matches. Poppe uses '-' for each MVS, matching the rest of the data.

source: mongoltoli.mn (Монгол хэлний их тайлбар толь, ШУА Хэл зохиолын хүрээлэн)
overrides.note: Genitive of ba; MT/WK use NNBSP, repo convention is MVS. Poppe grammar writes manu.
Question particle вэ/бэ = classical bui (бэ already correct in data).
